primary_endpoint: Percent change in fasting serum triglycerides from baseline to week 12.
efficacy_outcome: Mean percent changes were -0.44% with 300 mg and -20.27% with 600 mg; between-group p=0.517 (t-test) and p=0.345 (Wilcoxon).
safety_signal: Serious adverse events occurred in 0/2 participants in the 300 mg group and 1/3 in the 600 mg group; no deaths.
